parameters.formDescription: Record a manual compliance step (KYC, references, signing, payment, etc.). Each submission is logged for audit and may trigger the next workflow.

values.placeholder: SharePoint link to KYC report / signed letter / etc. (optional but recommended)
Context, conditions, or any flags for the next reviewer

nodes.name: Manual Signal Form
nodes.notes: ENTRY POINT - staff-facing n8n form for recording manual completion signals such as KYC complete, letter signed, payment received, or onboarding task completion.

nodes.name: Tool Signal Trigger
nodes.notes: MCP/SUB-WORKFLOW ENTRY POINT - structured trigger used by CAR Trigger MCP and other internal workflows. Accepts case_id, signal_type, evidence_url, notes, submitted_by.

nodes.name: Validate & Classify
nodes.notes: INPUT NORMALIZATION - accepts either form labels or snake_case MCP/sub-workflow fields. Validates numeric BIGINT case_id and classifies pre-DD vs post-DD signal handling.

nodes.name: Postgres: Insert audit row
nodes.notes: AUDIT LOG - records every manual signal submission in Postgres so manual actions remain traceable before any workflow branching runs.

nodes.name: IF: Pre-DD signal?
nodes.notes: SIGNAL ROUTER - TRUE branch sends DD gate signals to signal_completion; FALSE branch handles post-DD engagement/onboarding flags locally.

nodes.name: Execute: signal_completion
nodes.notes: DD GATE SIGNAL - calls the WF-07 signal_completion sub-workflow so pre-DD manual milestones can update car_case_gate_inputs.

parameters.query:
-- Flip the post-DD flag directly (signal_completion only handles pre-DD flags)
UPDATE car_case_gate_inputs
SET
  letter_signed       = CASE WHEN $2 = 'letter_signed'       THEN TRUE ELSE letter_signed       END,
  payment_received    = CASE WHEN $2 = 'payment_received'    THEN TRUE ELSE payment_received    END,
  loa_signed          = CASE WHEN $2 = 'loa_signed'          THEN TRUE ELSE loa_signed          END,
  contracts_executed  = CASE WHEN $2 = 'contracts_executed'  THEN TRUE ELSE contracts_executed  END
WHERE case_id = $1
RETURNING case_id, letter_signed, payment_received, loa_signed, contracts_executed;

nodes.name: Postgres: Set post-DD flag
nodes.notes: POST-DD FLAG UPDATE - stores manual engagement/onboarding completion state after DD, such as signed letter or payment received.

nodes.name: IF: Engagement ready for WF-09?
nodes.notes: CONTRACT READINESS GATE - checks whether the post-DD manual flags now satisfy the handoff criteria for WF-09 contract preparation.

nodes.name: Execute: WF-09 Contract Prep
nodes.notes: WF-09 HANDOFF - starts contract preparation once engagement-letter signing and deposit/payment prerequisites are recorded.
